note: Credentialed and capable — holds a PhD, has a main job, and is trying to free up capacity for a startup he founded in Pakistan — so he passes on profile, and health is plainly the neglected area rather than an emergency. He is also nowhere near the stated exclusion: 78 kg, doing 100 push-ups, 100 squats and 20-30 chin-ups a day, with real prior training under a coach. He misses on income and on starting point. Working one main job plus two side jobs is a signal of financial strain rather than success, he has already priced himself out of his former trainer, and money was the only blocker he named. And after three years of decline, ten kilos gained and self-described chronic fatigue, he is asking to be rescued back to a former baseline rather than to go from good to great — his own framing is 'terrible in terms of fitness' and wanting to get back to where he was in 2022. Judged on the criteria as written rather than on his enthusiasm, this is an edge case that the stated ICP would screen out on income.
